messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Horizant (gabapentin enacarbil, extended-release tablet) | Not approved | Adults | Adults (moderate to severe primary RLS)
Sources: FDA prescribing information for Neurontin, Gralise, and Horizant; Relgaabi prescribing information (DailyMed)
Triplet: ["Horizant", "has source", "FDA prescribing information for Gralise"]

The relation 'has source' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug's information is sourced from the document or entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
B. 'passes into': The subject drug is transferred or present in the substance or medium specified by the object entity.
C. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'used after': The subject drug is typically used following the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
